description.value: My Sushi is a Japanese-inspired restaurant in Fort St. John serving sushi rolls, miso soup, and pho. Located on 100 Street in the city centre, it offers both dine-in and online ordering with pickup and delivery. The menu blends Japanese staples with Vietnamese dishes, giving touring cyclists a solid hot-meal option in the Peace River region.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is live and fully corroborates the OSM record: same name, address (9824 100 St Fort St John, BC V1J 3Y1), and phone number ((778) 930-1548). Takeout is confirmed via the 'Order Online: Pickup Delivery' option on the location subpage. No mention of bike parking, washrooms, water refill, Wi-Fi, or any other cyclist-specific amenities appears anywhere on the site.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, operating sushi restaurant in Fort St. John with a confirmed active website, matching contact details, and online ordering. A useful meal stop for cyclists touring the Peace River region.

wow_evidence: Japanese-inspired restaurant in Fort St. John
